source: Issue #210 repro: ethers 6.17.0 from the cointmu-cli 1.7.0 tarball (4100ec6), eth_mining + eth_coinbase sent the way `mine start` sends them, against a JSON-RPC stub on 127.0.0.1:8585 that answers eth_coinbase like geth 1.10.26 with no etherbase set. `error` is the thrown error's own properties (stack left out); it has no `info`, and the batch only shows on the wire.

error.message: could not coalesce error (error={ "code": -32000, "message": "etherbase must be explicitly specified" }, payload={ "id": 3, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "eth_coinbase", "params": [  ] }, code=UNKNOWN_ERROR, version=6.17.0)
